furnace-repair.name: Kimberly Brewer
furnace-repair.text: Furnace went out within days of a major water leak. 2 other HVAC companies told me the leak damaged the furnace and a.c. I would need to replace both. Pierce came and within just a few minutes found a clogged part. Cleaned, everything worked. He said it was just a coincidence of timing. Not because of the leak. And obviously doesn't need replacement.
furnace-repair.fullText: Furnace went out within days of a major water leak. 2 other HVAC companies told me the leak damaged the furnace and a.c. I would need to replace both. Pierce came and within just a few minutes found a clogged part. Cleaned, everything worked. He said it was just a coincidence of timing. Not because of the leak. And obviously doesn't need replacement. I had called for a free estimate to give to my homeowners insurance. I asked how much I owed for cleaning/repair. I was told nothing. Just remember us when you're ready for maintenance or replacement in the future. Wow, in this day and age an actual honest service man with integrity! I will definitely call them with future needs. I also will let my insurance company know if anyone asks them for a reference to an HVAC company this is the one to refer their customers to. Thank you Pierce and MGI for honest service.

water-heaters.text: We decided to go electric with our water heater and HVAC systems and choose MGI from 4 different companies. We have a large house with a finished basement so the project wasn’t easy. They replaced the old systems with a heat pump water heater and a heat pump HVAC with back up furnace.
water-heaters.fullText: We decided to go electric with our water heater and HVAC systems and choose MGI from 4 different companies. We have a large house with a finished basement so the project wasn’t easy. They replaced the old systems with a heat pump water heater and a heat pump HVAC with back up furnace. Guillermo and Tristen did a great job of getting the old HVAC out and the new system installed and running IN TWO DAYS! Then Guillermo and Gus pulled our two existing water heaters and installed the new one in less than a day. These guys very thorough, informative and respectful to us, our dogs and most of all our home. We made the right decision to have MGI do our project and MGI made the right decision with these guys doing our job.
